In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. About the role: As the Sales Manager, CEE Export Markets East, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing sales strategy, driving revenue growth, and ensuring the sales team consistently meets and exceeds targets. You will be responsible for managing Distributors and indirectly external Sales Teams, handling sales process and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve Haleon business objectives. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities: Sales Strategy & Execution Strategic Vision: Define and implement the 2024–2026 Sales Roadmap to drive long-term growth. Channel Strategy: Develop and execute a strong channel approach across Mass Market and Pharmacy segments. Ownership & Accountability: Take full responsibility for achieving sales targets, delivering accurate forecasts, and ensuring outstanding customer satisfaction. Performance & Operational Excellence Sales Targets: Consistently meet ambitious goals for Sales In, Sales Out, and Stock in Trade across all channels. Operational KPIs: Ensure excellence in forecasting accuracy, distribution metrics (NDI, WDI), % GtN, and in-trade execution. Reporting & Action Planning: Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports with actionable plans to achieve objectives. Team & Customer Management Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Trade/Customer Marketing, NRM, and SFE teams to drive consumption growth. People Development: Promote team development and encourage the use of performance and growth tools. Team Leadership: Manage external sales teams effectively. Customer Management: Oversee partner relationships across channels, including selection and performance evaluation. Key Account Management: Lead strategic account programs and optimize trade spend. Requirements: Minimum 5 years in FMCG/FMCH management with proven success leading internal and external sales teams. Strong background in developing and executing commercial and channel strategies. Advanced forecasting and data analysis capabilities. Ability to foster teamwork and work cross-functionally. Skilled in identifying and leveraging opportunities for incremental revenue. Fluent in English or committed to achieving advanced proficiency within 3–6 months. Willingness to travel within the designated country. Experience analyzing channel partners’ net sales and sales-out data, and implementing corrective actions to meet targets. Why Haleon? Comprehensive Health Insurance. Life Insurance. Meal Allowance. Corporate car to make your commute comfortable. Additional Vacation Days & Additional Vacation Pay. Additional Maternity and Paternity Leave. Fitness Compensation. Referral Program. Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). Travel and Expenses. Job Posting End Date 2026-09-11 Equal Opportunities Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong. During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees. The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions. Adjustment or Accommodations Request If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence. Note to candidates The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

review_candidates.title: Sales Account Executive - Software de Simulação (CAE)
review_candidates.description: Se você é apaixonado por inovação, excelência e foco no cliente, seu lugar é na ESSS (esss.com) . A ESSS é uma empresa líder no fornecimento de tecnologias de engenharia baseada em simulação (SBES) e Ansys Apex Channel Partner . Nossa missão é ser o principal parceiro das empresas industriais na resolução de desafios relacionados à inovação, por meio de ferramentas de simulação numérica da Ansys . Para esta posição sua missão será garantir o crescimento sustentável de negócios nos clientes existentes ou nos novos clientes, prezando pela geração de negócios lucrativos e construindo uma relação de confiança junto a eles, tornando-se um advisor em relação a Simulação Computacional. Buscamos um Executivo de Negócios para atuar de forma híbrida no Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou remota em Minas Gerais. Principais Responsabilidades: Manter e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes existentes, garantindo satisfação e fidelização por meio de visitas periódicas, chamadas telefônicas ou e-mails de forma a entender suas necessidades e propor soluções que agreguem valor aos seus negócios. Criar estratégias comerciais para aumentar a participação da empresa no mercado, aumentando nosso “market share”. Realizar todas as atividades operacionais requeridas para o processo comercial de aquisição ou renovação de software/serviços, incluindo elaboração de propostas, apresentações, formulários/relatórios e atualização do CRM. Apoiar o Gerente de Negócios no planejamento estratégico da área (Business Plans) e planejamento de negócios do território (Territory Reviews) e clientes sob sua responsabilidade (Account Plans) definindo estratégias, planos de ação e formas de atuação com os clientes. Ministrar treinamentos internos, transmitindo os conhecimentos necessários para o desenvolvimento de atividades/processos para as equipes de vendas. Ter disponibilidade para realizar viagens nacionais e internacionais, conforme planejamento prévio. Requisitos Exigidos: Conhecimento em vendas consultivas diretas (B2B) de software para engenharia e áreas correlatas. Conhecimento e experiência em negociação de contratos multianuais. Experiência em atendimento a clientes de grande porte, corporações com diferentes unidades de negócio, desenvolvimento de relacionamento executivo. Conhecimento em soluções para Engenharia, Desenvolvimento de Produto, Manutenção e Automação Industrial. Portfólio de soluções da sua unidade de negócios. Conhecimento de clientes/mercado/concorrência. Além de uma remuneração competitiva, oferecemos: Cartão de benefícios flexíveis (Alimentação, Mobilidade, Cultura, Saúde, Home-Office) disponibilizado via cartão SWILE; Plano de saúde com cobertura integral para o colaborador e sem coparticipação (Bradesco - Nacional); Incentivo a educação continuada através de cursos, treinamentos, especializações e auxílio idiomas. Modalidade de trabalho híbrido, combinando atividades remotas e presenciais no escritório (2 dias remotos); Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida, entre outros benefícios.

review_candidates.title: Reliability & Asset Management Senior Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation
review_candidates.description: At First Quantum, we free the talent of our people by taking a very different approach which is underpinned by a very different, very definite culture – the “First Quantum Way”. Working with us is not like working anywhere else, which is why we recruit people who will take a bolder, smarter approach to spot opportunities, solve problems and deliver results. Our culture is all about encouraging you to think independently and to challenge convention to deliver the best result. That’s how we continue to achieve extraordinary things in extraordinary locations. Job Description Asset Management Support the implementation and maintenance of the Smelter Asset Management Framework and associated standards for the fixed plant and mobile equipment assets. Develop and maintain accurate asset registers and equipment hierarchies in Pronto. Monitor asset health indicators and identify deterioration trends requiring maintenance intervention. Manage the strategy, governance, and optimization of the reliability maintenance initiatives to prevent related mechanical failures. Build and maintain asset health indices combining equipment age, thickness test data, and operating history to predict remaining useful life. Carry out periodic asset condition assessments and asset health reviews. Assist with equipment risk assessments and identification of mitigation measures. Support the rollout and implementation of the digital maintenance platforms such as the OnPlan platform. Reliability and Performance Monitoring Monitor the reliability of HV/LV systems, MCCs, transformers, PLC, DCS, SCADA and field instrumentation through KPI tracking and data analysis. Monitor asset health indicators and performance metrics to identify reliability risks and improvement opportunities for smelter E&I equipment. Collect, analyse, and report on asset reliability, availability, maintainability, and utilization data. Lead Root Cause Failure Analyses (RCFA), Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and related improvement studies. Identify recurring equipment failures and assist in developing reliability improvement initiatives. Support implementation of preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs. Generate periodic reliability and asset performance reports for management review. Asset Information and Analytics Collect, analyse, and interpret the Electrical and Instrumentation equipment performance data. Develop asset health reports, reliability reports, and KPI dashboards. Utilize Power BI, CMMS, PI System, RtDUET, and other digital platforms to support asset management decisions. Support data-driven decision-making through performance analysis and reporting. Assist with reliability forecasting and equipment risk assessments. Produce monthly equipment health and reliability reports. Maintain asset performance dashboards and reports using Power BI and other reporting tools. Maintain asset management KPIs and performance scorecards. Participate in digital asset management initiatives and implementation of asset analytics systems. Maintain accurate E&I asset registers Participate in digital asset management initiatives and implementation of asset analytics systems. Asset Strategy and Maintenance Optimization Assist in evaluating preventive maintenance effectiveness and recommend improvements. Support critical equipment reviews and maintenance task analyses. Contribute to spare parts optimization initiatives through analysis of equipment criticality and maintenance history. Support shutdown planning teams by providing asset-related information and performance trending. Continuous Improvement Review the effectiveness of existing PM (Preventive Maintenance) and PdM (Predictive Maintenance) routines against actual equipment failure history. Identify opportunities for improving asset performance, and maintenance effectiveness Collaborate with various disciplines to define safe operating envelopes, preventing equipment operators from running mechanical equipment outside design limits. Support the Implementation of new reliability technologies and maintenance methodologies Participate in reliability improvement projects. Monitor outcomes of improvement initiatives and report achieved benefits. Promote a culture of reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHEQ) Comply with all company policies, procedures, legal requirements, and industry standards relating to safety, health, environment, and quality. Demonstrate a commitment to maintaining a safe workplace and promote safe work practices in all asset management activities. Ensure asset management activities align with company safety and environmental requirements. Participate in risk assessments, incident investigations, and corrective action implementation where required. KEY COMPETENCIES A deep understanding of High Voltage (HV) and Low Voltage (LV) distribution networks, switchgear, transformers, and protection relays. A deep understanding of Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), and SCADA architecture Maintenance strategy development Asset health and performance monitoring and analysis Sound knowledge of Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM) techniques, such as Vibration Analysis, Thermography and Oil Analysis. Reliability data analysis and trend identification. Equipment criticality assessment and risk evaluation. Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) participation and support. Power BI dashboard development and data visualization. Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) proficiency (e.g., PRONTO, SAP). Maintenance cost and lifecycle cost analysis. Spare parts optimization and inventory support. Technical report writing and presentation skills. Problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies. General knowledge of defect elimination methodologies and their interpretation. Working knowledge of all applicable electrical industry standards and mining regulations. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical and Instrumentation or a closely related Engineering discipline Certification in Asset Management, or Reliability Engineering will be an added advantage (ARP, CMRP, etc) Certification in Condition Monitoring Techniques will be an added advantage Power BI or advanced analytic training will also be an added advantage Experience At least 5 years’ experience in maintenance, reliability, asset management or engineering role in the mining/mineral processing industry. Smelter experience will be an added advantage. Demonstrated experience working at a senior level in electrical engineering, control and instrumentation engineering, or PLC specialist. Demonstrated experience in the development of reports and KPIs through data driven decision-making. Demonstrated experience in asset performance monitoring and reliability improvement initiatives. Experience in RCA reviews and asset strategy optimization Experience in optimizing preventive and condition-based maintenance programs. Power BI skills and knowledge Exposure to digital asset management technologies, and analytics platforms. Demonstrated skills in verbal and written communications, planning and organizing Experience with the use of a computerized maintenance management system (such as PRONTO, SAP or similar systems) Solid computer skills including use of MS Office (Word, Excel & Outlook) Exposure to ISO 55000 Asset Management principles undefined BEHAVIOURAL TRAITS Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse equipment performance data, identify trends, diagnose issues, and support the implementation of effective solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintains a high level of accuracy in asset data, reporting, analysis, and documentation. Problem Solving: Applies structured and practical approaches to resolve asset performance and reliability challenges. Planning & Organization: Effectively manages priorities, coordinates activities, and ensures timely completion of assigned tasks. Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, with stakeholders at all levels. Collaboration: Works effectively with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Planning, and other support functions to achieve common objectives. Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities to improve asset performance, maintenance effectiveness, and operational efficiency. Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities and delivers work to agreed standards and timelines. Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilizes asset and maintenance data to support recommendations and informed decision-making. Initiative: Demonstrates a proactive approach to identifying issues, opportunities, and improvement actions. Customer Focus: Understands and supports the operational needs of internal stakeholders to achieve business objectives. Innovation: Identifies and implements new ideas, technologies, and approaches to improve reliability, efficiency, and performance of the smelter.
